speaker: author (devotional voice)
question: No technique enjoined: whatever sounds is already transcendent mantra, whatever the body postures is already mudrā, whatever the breath's flow is already wonderful yoga — so, in the experienced śākta abode, what would not shine?
premises: Whatever sounds is already transcendent mantra.
Whatever postures is already mudrā; whatever breath flows is already wonderful yoga.
In the experienced śākta abode, what would not shine?
inference: No technique enjoined; recognition, not practice.
uncertainties: Whether 'śākta dhāma' means the abode of Śakti or the abode of the śākta is unresolved.
